proposal: Lower the football:eliteserien coverage contract (authority.json) minUpcoming from 4 → 2 so its recurring FALSE high-severity contract-breach during international breaks stops firing. Eliteserien is boarded by the ESPN nor.1 fetcher, whose fill window is only ~5–6 days; during a landslagspause the next round's far half (7–9 days out) is inside the 14-day horizon in reality but not yet fetched onto the board, so demanding a near-full round (min 4) within the horizon is unsatisfiable through the break window. minUpcoming=2 still proves the league is LIVE on the board and a dead fetcher (upcoming 0–1) still breaches; round completeness is coverage-critic/coverage-gaps' job, not the contract's. horizonDays stays 14 (it must span the ~10-day break so the next round counts once fetched — bumping horizon can't add un-fetched matches, so minUpcoming is the correct lever). Single-value config tune of an existing WP-243 mechanism; touches no protected path. Direct precedent: PR #457 (golf:pga-tour horizon recalibration).
evidence: coverage-contracts.json history (last 20 days, 88 static-pipeline runs): football:eliteserien status 'breached' 8 times, ALL clustered on the 05.–06.09 international-break weekend, upcoming 2–3 vs minUpcoming 4. Every other run in the window was 'met' — a break-window artifact, not a coverage failure.

research-log.json (2026-09-06 21:02Z): the research agent triaged the breach as a 'SELV-LØSENDE FETCHER-VINDU-FALSKPOSITIV' and left a standing flag FOR improve/self-repair — 'kontraktens 14-d-horisont overgår nor.1-fetcherens ~5–6-d-vindu → falskt brudd hver helg der inneværende runde er ferdig før neste entrer vinduet.'

coverage-audit.json (2026-09-07 08:35Z): coverage-critic independently confirmed Eliteserien coverage is actually fine on cadence (this weekend's round complete, 13.–14.09 fills within 1–2 days). Two independent agents diagnosed the same false breach — same pattern that triggered PR #457.

authority.schema.json contract description: 'Sett KONSERVATIVE tall (landslagspauser, sommerferier) — et falskt brudd koster agent-triage og G2-støy.' minUpcoming=4 was not conservative enough for Eliteserien's international breaks; the schema minimum is 1, so 2 validates.

Simulated the fix against scripts/lib/coverage-contracts.js assessContracts at now=2026-09-06: upcoming=3 → met, upcoming=2 → met (both observed false breaches flip), upcoming=1 → breached, upcoming=0 → breached (a genuinely dead fetcher is still caught). npm test: 1537 passed (88 files) — the two tests referencing minUpcoming:4 use inline fixtures, not authority.json's value, so they are unaffected.
notes: Chose minUpcoming (4→2) over horizonDays: bumping the horizon (the golf PR #457 lever) can't help here because the matches aren't on the board regardless of horizon — the ESPN nor.1 fetcher simply hasn't fetched the far half of the post-break round yet. Reducing minUpcoming is the only lever that removes the false positive; 2 is the tightest value that clears every observed breach (lowest observed breach was upcoming=2), so it keeps the most teeth.

Why this doesn't mask real breaches: the WP-243 contract is a coarse 'is this wholesale competition alive on the board in-season' guarantee, not a round-completeness check (that is coverage-critic/coverage-gaps, which stay recall-biased and web-cross-check). A broken/frozen Eliteserien fetcher drives upcoming toward 0, which still breaches at min 2; the independent stale-retained / source-anomaly signals catch a dead fetcher too.

How we'll know it worked: football:eliteserien returns/stays 'met' across the next international-break weekend, the false HIGH gap stops appearing in coverage-gaps.json / the port-report contracts port, and research/coverage-critic stop spending a triage note on it each run through the break. Premier League (min 6) and the other five contracts are untouched — PL plays every weekend with a well-populated ESPN eng.1 window, so it never hits this fetcher-window gap.

Did not touch the standing HIGH sourceIssues (no wholesale UEFA CL/EL/ECL fetcher, no handball fetcher, no Serie A/Bundesliga ESPN fetchers) — those add machinery and are self-repair-owned/bigger; this run fixes the clearest-evidenced misfiring threshold, per one-improvement-per-run and the sharpen-what-exists bias.
